assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: original portrait 4:5 photographic artwork for an Indonesian Loka Kasir sales-partner commission campaign. Primary request: a photorealistic, warm candid editorial scene of a young Indonesian male independent software sales partner in an ordinary navy overshirt meeting an Indonesian woman bakery owner wearing a warm taupe hijab at her modest neighborhood bakery counter. They review a simple blank unbranded tablet together, with naturally posed hands, fresh bread trays, a small receipt printer and genuine worn wood textures. Fictional models and fictional business, not a testimonial. Camera at counter height, intimate three-quarter medium shot, modern documentary advertising craft, soft morning window light. Composition concentrates people and bakery scene in the bottom two thirds, with a quiet warm cream wall in the upper third reserved for separately typeset copy. Navy, cobalt accents, ivory and warm natural bakery colors. Distinct from a cartoon coffee-stall meeting; real photographic textures, no 3D/cartoon style. No visible words, letters, digits, signs, logos, charts, banknotes, earnings claims, floating currency, watermark or software UI. The tablet screen must be blank. No A/B/C cards or generic infographic comparison panels.
